clause: Raster focus-stack / seamless-blend (auto-blend layers) composite op [STU-RAS-051,STU-CON-007]
summary: Implement the focus-stack / seamless-blend composite operation over a multi-layer stack: auto-align (reuse existing align primitive), then per-region select and blend the sharpest/best-exposed content into one seamless masked composite (extended depth of field + seamless panorama/exposure blending). Non-destructive masked output; model-steerable command reusing auto-align, statistical-stack (STU-RAS-014), masking (STU-RAS-018), HDR/exposure (STU-RAS-033) primitives.
expected_tests: live: focus-stack over a 3-layer stack produces a seamless masked composite; deterministic (seeded) + byte-stable on backend
risk_if_missed: Focus-stacking/seamless-blend (a named MD/Photoshop-class op) absent despite enabling primitives existing.

entries: Studio / Raster / Focus stack & seamless blend

acceptance: auto-align + per-region sharpest/best-exposed blend -> seamless masked composite; deterministic; visually verified

summary: Suite-wide conformance harness proving [STU-CON-007](c): for EVERY Studio mutating command, the same inputs produce byte-stable output on a given backend and output within the declared tolerance across GPU backends/drivers (MeshComparator/pixel-tolerance per STU-CON-005); any stochastic command exposes an explicit seed making it deterministic. Enumerates all registered command_ids, runs each with fixed inputs+seed twice on one backend (byte-equal) and cross-backend (within epsilon), and asserts full EventLedger replay reproduces the result. Fails closed on any non-deterministic mutating command.
expected_tests: live: enumerate all mutating command_ids; each byte-stable on-backend + within-tolerance cross-backend + EventLedger-replay-equal
negative: an unseeded stochastic command fails the gate
risk_if_missed: Parallel model edits not reproducible; STU-CON-007(c) unenforced across the surface.
proof_targets: suite-wide determinism + cross-backend tolerance + replay gate
acceptance: every mutating command deterministic on-backend + within-tolerance cross-backend + replayable; unseeded stochastic fails closed

summary: Suite-wide conformance harness proving [STU-CON-007](b): for EVERY Studio mutating command, the mutation routes through the per-file CRDT document + file-scoped lease + EventLedger-idempotent promotion path (MT-013), never a direct authority write. Runs the swarm harness with N concurrent model agents issuing the SAME and DIFFERENT commands on multiple files AND on one shared file; asserts no corruption, no silent overwrite, deterministic promotion ordering, conflict surfacing, and no interference with a concurrent operator session on a different project. Fails closed on any command that mutates authority outside the CRDT+lease+promotion path.
expected_tests: swarm: N agents x multi-file + N agents x one-file concurrent edits -> no corruption, idempotent promotion, conflicts surfaced
negative: a command writing authority outside CRDT+lease+promotion fails the gate
test: concurrent operator on other project unaffected
risk_if_missed: Parallel multi-model/multi-file editing can corrupt state; STU-CON-007(b) unenforced (the audit's biggest gap).
acceptance: every mutating command CRDT+lease+idempotent-promotion routed; multi-model multi-file safe; operator-isolated; direct-write fails closed

summary: Suite-wide conformance harness proving [STU-CON-007](d): for EVERY Studio command producing visual output, the result is inspectable through the headless StudioRenderHarness render capture (MT-008) + Argus (MT-547), with before/after evidence, no foreground UI, and no focus steal. Enumerates all visual-output command_ids; runs each and asserts a render-harness pixel capture (real-GPU) or AccessKit-tree/state assertion (headless fallback) plus an Argus author_id inspection is produced. Fails closed on any visual-output command with no render/Argus proof path.
expected_tests: live: every visual-output command_id yields render-harness capture (real-GPU) or AccessKit fallback (headless) + Argus inspection + before/after evidence
negative: a visual command with no render/Argus path fails the gate
risk_if_missed: Models cannot deterministically verify visual edits (photos/masks/layouts); STU-CON-007(d) unenforced.
acceptance: every visual-output command render-harness/Argus verifiable with before/after evidence; headless-safe; no focus steal

summary: Suite-wide conformance harness proving [STU-CON-007](a) + [STU-MDL-006]: EVERY Studio editing capability is reachable through the typed model command API with command_id + auto-generated input/output schema + dry_run + SimulationReceipt + undo semantics; any operator-only/headless capability carries a typed reason. Enumerates every operator-facing tool/command/panel action and asserts a matching model command_id exists (or a typed operator_only_reason). Fails closed on any editing capability with no model path and no reason.
expected_tests: live: every operator editing action maps to a model command_id (dry_run+receipt+undo) or a typed operator_only_reason
negative: an editing capability with no model path + no reason fails the gate
risk_if_missed: Some tools operator-only; parallel agents cannot drive the full surface; STU-CON-007(a)/STU-MDL-006 unenforced.
acceptance: every editing capability model-invokable (dry_run/receipt/undo) or typed-reason operator-only; no unreasoned operator-only

summary: WP-closeout gate binding the four universal conformance gates (MT-556 determinism, MT-557 parallel-safety, MT-558 visual-verifiability, MT-559 model-invokability) into one [STU-CON-007] pass/fail: the Studio WP MUST NOT close while any of the four gates reports a failing command. Also verifies each per-domain conformance MT (raster MT-021/067, vector, layout MT-190, typography MT-230, color MT-260, effects MT-301, design-system MT-340, prototype MT-386/400, raw MT-432, interop MT-480, automation MT-520, whiteboard MT-540) enumerates all four properties per [STU-CON-007]. Produces the STU-CON-007 conformance report.
expected_tests: gate: all four universal conformance gates green across the full command surface; per-domain conformance MTs enumerate all four properties
risk_if_missed: The universal parallel+deterministic+visual+model guarantee not enforced at closeout; operator's core requirement unproven.
acceptance: WP cannot close while any STU-CON-007 property fails on any command; conformance report produced; per-domain blocks enumerate all four
